name: kaseya-bms-mcp
description: The first dedicated CLI and MCP server for Kaseya BMS - the full PSA surface plus offline sync, full-text search, and the queue, contract-burn, and unbilled-revenue analytics the web grid can't compute.

kaseya_bms_bearer_auth.title: KASEYA_BMS_BEARER_AUTH
kaseya_bms_bearer_auth.description: Optional. Sets KASEYA_BMS_BEARER_AUTH for the Kaseya BMS MCP server.

kaseya_bms_token.title: KASEYA_BMS_TOKEN
kaseya_bms_token.description: Optional pre-minted JWT; when set it wins over the login and nothing is minted.

kaseya_bms_password.title: BMS password
kaseya_bms_password.description: Password for KASEYA_BMS_USERNAME. Exchanged for a JWT; never sent on data calls.

kaseya_bms_tenant.title: BMS tenant
kaseya_bms_tenant.description: Your company name exactly as it appears under My Settings in BMS. The authenticate call rejects the login without it.

kaseya_bms_username.title: BMS username
kaseya_bms_username.description: Kaseya BMS API user login. With the password and tenant, the connector mints a short-lived JWT on first use and again when it expires.

kaseya_bms_base_url.title: Kaseya BMS API base URL
kaseya_bms_base_url.description: Base URL for the Kaseya BMS API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

kaseya_bms_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
kaseya_bms_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

kaseya_bms_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
kaseya_bms_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

kaseya_bms_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
kaseya_bms_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

kaseya_bms_user_agent.title: User-Agent header (optional)
kaseya_bms_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Kaseya BMS requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
